Note: the interact with button omitted (first one) produced NO error and NO fail line — it was skipped silently (like numeric). The empty string "" errored. So omitting button = skipped.

I've now exhausted an enormous vocabulary. Let me think completely differently. The error format is "unknown-input: X". This is the SAME validator as raw_input keys. So the valid set is a specific list of **input names**. What input names would a game engine use? 

Given "e" and "space" fail, but these are the most common... unless the game uses **arrow keys** and a **specific action key**. Let me try the actual arrow key names and common game keys I haven't: "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "Tab", "Shift", "Control", "Alt", "Backspace", "Delete", "Home", "End", "PageUp", "PageDown", "F1", "F2".

Also single letters I haven't tried: "q","r","t","g","z","v","b","n","m","h","j","k","l","u","i","o","p","y","w","s","d","f","c".

Let me batch a wide probe of raw_input keys — single letters and arrow/function keys.
